props.rule: Pregame only. One leg per player (his highest-chance line priced -1000 to +150), at most 2 legs per game in a parlay, each leg in at most 5 tickets. Players listed Out/Doubtful/Questionable/Day-To-Day by ESPN are excluded. Only legs with est. chance ≥60% and not worse than FanDuel's own price by >2 pts.
